series.name: Single zone wall-mounted HVAC common error codes (DFS-TP-AH-001-US)
series.notes: LG tech paper 'Defining Common Error Codes' LS091HSV/LS121HSV (official PDF, high). Numeric codes on US single-zone wall-mount; model-scoped from universal split sheet.

meaning.en: Indoor unit middle pipe thermistor has disconnected or shorted.
meaning.ur: Indoor unit ka middle pipe thermistor disconnect ho gaya ya short ho gaya hai

causes.en: Sensor plug loose on indoor PCB
causes.ur: Indoor PCB par sensor plug loose

causes.en: On Dual Inverter tech videos also associated with low gas / sensor group checks
causes.ur: Dual Inverter tech videos mein isay gas kam / sensor group checks se bhi jora jata hai

solutions.en: Reseat sensor; measure resistance; replace if bad
solutions.ur: Sensor dobara lagayein; resistance napein; kharab ho to badal dein

solutions.en: If sensors OK, technician checks charge/leak path when CH12 used as gas-low proxy on some models
solutions.ur: Sensors theek hon to kuch models mein CH12 jab gas-kam ka indicator banta hai, technician charge/leak path check karta hai
Marammat ke baad power cycle karein

notes.en: Tech-paper definition high confidence; Dual Inverter 'gas low' gloss medium — both recorded, conflict flagged in quarantine 4c.
notes.ur: Tech-paper wali definition high confidence hai, Dual Inverter ki 'gas low' wali gloss medium — dono record ki gayi hain, conflict quarantine 4c mein flag hai.

title.ur: CT thermistor ka current bahut kam

meaning.en: Current to the current transformer (CT) thermistor circuit is too low.
meaning.ur: Current transformer (CT) thermistor circuit mein current bahut kam hai

causes.en: CT sense circuit open or disconnected on inverter PCB
causes.ur: Inverter PCB par CT sense circuit khula ya disconnected

solutions.en: Inspect CT wiring and sense network on outdoor PCB
solutions.ur: Outdoor PCB par CT wiring aur sense network check karein

solutions.en: Compare with code 40 CT short/open family
solutions.ur: Code 40 (CT short/open family) se compare karein

solutions.en: Replace outdoor PCB if path failed
solutions.ur: CT path kharab ho to outdoor PCB replace karein

notes.en: Unique to this paper among sources gathered; not on Universal sheet.
notes.ur: Jo sources jama kiye gaye un mein yeh sirf is paper par hai; Universal sheet par nahi hai.

codes.blinkPattern: Indoor/outdoor LED1 3x / LED2 1x (also outdoor LED1 3x / LED2 1x on ODU PCB map)

title.en: Communication failure indoor to outdoor (numeric models)
title.ur: Numeric display models mein andar se bahar communication fail

meaning.en: Communication failure from indoor unit to outdoor unit on numeric LED display models.
meaning.ur: Numeric LED display wale models mein indoor unit se outdoor unit ki communication nakaam

causes.ur: Kisi ek taraf PCB fault ho sakta hai

solutions.en: Same diagnostic as CH05 (code 05 Series A)
solutions.ur: CH05 jaisi hi diagnostic (Series A code 05)

solutions.en: Repair wiring or replace faulty PCB
solutions.ur: Wiring ki marammat karein ya kharab PCB badal dein

notes.en: Confirms numeric 5 == CH05 family on dual-LED models.
notes.ur: Yeh confirm karta hai ke dual-LED models par numeric 5 CH05 family ke hi hai.

meaning.en: Communication failure from outdoor unit to indoor unit.
meaning.ur: Outdoor unit se indoor unit ki communication nakaam.

causes.en: Serial line open/short or ODU PCB not sending
causes.ur: Serial line khula/short ya ODU PCB send nahi kar raha
IDU signal receive nahi kar raha / wiring mein fault

solutions.en: LED map on this paper: indoor LED1 5x / LED2 3x
solutions.ur: Is paper par LED map: indoor LED1 5x / LED2 3x
Cable ya PCB ki marammat karein
